design_notes: Refinement of setup_taxonomy v1.0. (1) The over-broad single-asset-microcap-binary tag (~half the corpus) is SPLIT into three stage/decisiveness sub-setups so no setup exceeds ~30% of the corpus. (2) Adds two orthogonal single-value controlled vocabularies for retrieval: disease_area (20, one per node) and mechanism_class (19, one per node). Setups stay multi-label; disease_area and mechanism_class are single-label. All 15 other v1 setups are unchanged.

setups.name: pivotal-company-defining-binary
setups.definition: A single-asset (or single-lead) company whose value hinges on a PIVOTAL company-defining event now: a Phase 3 topline, an accepted BLA/NDA PDUFA, or the sole-remaining registrational trial. Clinical result and the go/no-go for the whole enterprise resolve at this print. Thin float amplifies the move both ways.
ex_ante_cues: one lead asset carries the valuation AND the catalyst is Phase 3 / PDUFA / registrational
sole-remaining pivotal after a prior trial
accepted BLA/NDA with a firm action date
microcap/small-cap where this readout is 'the company'
no meaningful going-concern/dilution overhang dominating the tape (else -> going-concern-binary)
setups.typical_outcome: Extreme bimodal: multi-bagger on a clean pivotal hit / catastrophic (-50% to -95%) on a miss; the single most decisive binary bucket.

setups.name: single-asset-going-concern-binary
setups.definition: A single-asset binary where the clinical/regulatory result AND corporate solvency resolve together — a make-or-break readout landing on a name with short runway, going-concern language, dilution/warrant/reverse-split overhang, or a raise that must clear around the catalyst. The setup is 'data risk stacked on funding risk'. Co-fires with financing-overhang-going-concern.
ex_ante_cues: single lead asset AND runway<~18mo / going-concern / telegraphed punitive raise
warrants, ATM, registered-direct, reverse split or Q-suffix ticker alongside the binary
good data can still be faded because a dilutive raise is near-certain
the raise must precede or ride with the catalyst
setups.typical_outcome: Negative-to-bimodal: even hits are muted until the raise clears; misses are terminal. Distinct from pivotal-company-defining-binary because solvency, not just efficacy, is on the line.

setups.name: early-mid-stage-single-asset-signal
setups.definition: A single-asset name whose current catalyst is an EARLY/MID-stage signal — Phase 1/2/2b proof-of-concept, dose-finding, or interim/biomarker readout — decisive for the program's trajectory but not yet the company-defining approval binary. Sets up (or kills) a future pivotal rather than resolving the franchise now.
ex_ante_cues: one lead asset AND catalyst is Phase 1 / Phase 2 / Phase 2b / dose-finding / PoC / interim
result gates whether a pivotal even gets run
valuation rests on a single early asset with no approved product yet
setups.typical_outcome: Large but less-terminal moves than a pivotal binary; non-monotonic/single-dose hits often sell off; a clean PoC re-rates the shell, a miss de-funds the next study.

disease_areas.name: psychiatry-cns
disease_areas.definition: Mood, psychotic, anxiety, sleep/wake and addiction disorders (schizophrenia, MDD, GAD, bipolar, PPD, narcolepsy/EDS, fibromyalgia, autism, ADHD, substance use).

disease_areas.name: immunology-inflammation
disease_areas.definition: Systemic autoimmune/inflammatory disease (SLE, RA, PsA, IgG4-RD, MS, IBD/UC, systemic sclerosis, myositis, HS, GBS, angioedema).

disease_areas.name: neurodegeneration
disease_areas.definition: Progressive CNS degeneration (ALS, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, ataxias, PSP, Lewy-body, Alexander/Friedreich).

disease_areas.name: dermatology
disease_areas.definition: Skin-primary disease (atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, alopecia, seborrheic dermatitis, prurigo, molluscum, epidermolysis bullosa/RDEB, urticaria, GPP, cosmetic).

disease_areas.name: respiratory
disease_areas.definition: Airway/lung disease (asthma, COPD, bronchiectasis, chronic cough, IPF/ILD, CRS/nasal polyps, MAC/NTM lung, CF-pulmonary, PH-ILD, PAP).

disease_areas.name: cardiovascular
disease_areas.definition: Structural/functional cardiovascular disease AND cardiometabolic lipid disorders (ATTR-CM, HCM, HF, PAH/PH, hypertension, stroke/aSAH; plus FCS/severe-HTG/dyslipidemia/ApoC3/ANGPTL3).

disease_areas.name: ophthalmology
disease_areas.definition: Eye disease (wet AMD, DME, RVO, dry eye, thyroid eye disease, retinitis pigmentosa, PVR, corneal defect, presbyopia).

disease_areas.name: oncology-solid
disease_areas.definition: Solid tumors (NSCLC, breast, ovarian, GIST, pancreatic, biliary, glioma/GBM, melanoma, endometrial, desmoid, NPC).

disease_areas.name: neurology-epilepsy-migraine-pain
disease_areas.definition: Non-degenerative neurology: epilepsy/seizures & DEE, essential tremor/movement, migraine, chronic/neuropathic pain, Long COVID.

disease_areas.name: endocrine-obesity
disease_areas.definition: Endocrine & weight/metabolic-hormone disease (obesity, T2D/diabetes, acromegaly, CAH, adrenal insufficiency, hypogonadism/TRT, hypoparathyroidism, hyperinsulinism, osteoporosis).

disease_areas.name: oncology-heme
disease_areas.definition: Hematologic malignancy & related (AML, ALL/B-ALL, lymphoma, CTCL, myeloma, AL amyloidosis, GVHD, MDS).

disease_areas.name: nephrology
disease_areas.definition: Kidney disease (IgAN, FSGS, lupus nephritis, CKD, hyperphosphatemia, Alport, Fabry renal).

disease_areas.name: neuromuscular
disease_areas.definition: Neuromuscular disease (DMD, SMA, myasthenia gravis, LGMD, FSHD, muscle preservation).

disease_areas.name: gastroenterology-hepatology
disease_areas.definition: GI & liver disease (GERD/H. pylori, IBS, hepatic encephalopathy, cholestatic liver, NASH/MASH).

disease_areas.name: infectious-disease-vaccines
disease_areas.definition: Anti-infectives & vaccines (cUTI, CRAB, C. difficile, HBV/HDV, HPV/RRP, fungal, catheter-BSI, pertussis; COVID/pneumococcal/influenza vaccines).

disease_areas.name: allergy-anaphylaxis
disease_areas.definition: Acute allergy/anaphylaxis rescue & desensitization (epinephrine devices, peanut allergy, allergic urticaria).

disease_areas.name: rare-genetic-metabolic
disease_areas.definition: Rare monogenic/metabolic disease (PKU, arginase/urea-cycle, Wilson, lysosomal/MPS, nonsense-mutation genetic diseases, achondroplasia, lymphatic malformation).

disease_areas.name: hematology-nonmalignant
disease_areas.definition: Non-malignant blood disease (sickle cell, thalassemia, PK deficiency, polycythemia vera, hemolytic anemia, transfusion products).

disease_areas.name: urology-gynecology
disease_areas.definition: Genitourinary & reproductive/sexual health (stress urinary incontinence, dysmenorrhea, female sexual arousal disorder).

disease_areas.name: supportive-procedural-other
disease_areas.definition: Oncology-supportive / procedural / recovery indications not tied to a disease-modifying drug (ototoxicity prevention, post-surgical muscle recovery).

mechanism_classes.name: reformulation-delivery-device
mechanism_classes.definition: Known/known-class drug differentiated by delivery or formulation (sublingual/oral films, intranasal epinephrine, inhaled/dry-powder, apomorphine infusion, ingestible/patch, drug-device combos, 505(b)(2) reformulations).

mechanism_classes.name: monoclonal-antibody
mechanism_classes.definition: Monoclonal antibodies incl. bispecifics, nanobodies/VHH, T-cell engagers and complement mAbs (anti-IL, anti-IGF-1R, anti-VEGF mAb, anti-CD19, anti-C1q, anti-amyloid).

mechanism_classes.name: small-molecule-other
mechanism_classes.definition: Small molecules not otherwise classed: misc oral/topical agents, anti-infective SM (carbapenem, echinocandin, antibiotic lock), chemo (anthracycline), PDE5, hormones, plant-derived.

mechanism_classes.name: small-molecule-cns
mechanism_classes.definition: CNS-active small molecules (muscarinic, VMAT2, orexin OX2R, NMDA/dextromethorphan-bupropion, kappa-opioid, ion-channel/Kv7/Nav, NK-1, gamma-secretase, neurosteroid, psychedelic).

mechanism_classes.name: small-molecule-enzyme-receptor
mechanism_classes.definition: Small-molecule enzyme/receptor modulators outside CNS/kinase (P-CAB, NHE3, DPP1, aldosterone synthase, THR-beta, SST2, ACTH-R, endothelin/ARB, myosin modulators, PKR activators).

mechanism_classes.name: recombinant-protein-enzyme-biologic
mechanism_classes.definition: Recombinant proteins/enzymes/cytokines/toxins incl. enzyme-replacement & brain-penetrant TransportVehicle ERT, GM-CSF, IL-2, immunotoxins, botulinum, recombinant human proteins.

mechanism_classes.name: small-molecule-kinase-targeted-onc
mechanism_classes.definition: Targeted-oncology & immune small molecules acting on kinases/nuclear transport (TKIs, RAF/MEK, menin, BTK, JAK/TYK2, XPO1/SINE, GSK-3, MK2, telomere agents).

mechanism_classes.name: cell-therapy
mechanism_classes.definition: Cell-based therapeutics (CAR-T, cardiosphere-derived/allogeneic cells, autologous bone-marrow, TCR-Treg, cell-sheet).

mechanism_classes.name: antisense-oligonucleotide
mechanism_classes.definition: RNA-targeted antisense oligonucleotides incl. LICA/GalNAc-conjugated ASO (ApoC3, TTR, SOD1, GFAP, prekallikrein, ANGPTL3).

mechanism_classes.name: april-blys-baff-fusion
mechanism_classes.definition: APRIL/BLyS/BAFF-axis biologics — dual-pathway fusion proteins and IL-17A/BAFF bispecifics (atacicept, tibulizumab).

mechanism_classes.name: gene-therapy
mechanism_classes.definition: In-vivo & ex-vivo gene therapy (AAV vectors, HSV-1 topical gene therapy, ex-vivo gene-corrected cell-sheets).

mechanism_classes.name: peptide-therapeutic
mechanism_classes.definition: Peptide/peptide-mimetic drugs (MC4R setmelanotide, IL-23R peptide, hepcidin mimetic, PTH prodrug, relaxin-adjacent peptides).

mechanism_classes.name: live-biotherapeutic-microbiome-phage
mechanism_classes.definition: Live/biologic ecosystem therapeutics — bacteriophage, microbiome/fecal consortia, engineered live bacteria, cell-derived secretome.

mechanism_classes.name: fusion-protein-fc
mechanism_classes.definition: Engineered Fc-fusion proteins & ligand traps not on the APRIL/BAFF axis (Fc-relaxin RXFP1 agonist, activin ligand traps, FcRn/Fc-engineered).

mechanism_classes.name: adc-radioconjugate
mechanism_classes.definition: Payload-conjugated targeting agents — antibody-drug conjugates, antibody radioconjugates, muscle-targeting oligo conjugates (FORCE).

mechanism_classes.name: vaccine-dna-mrna
mechanism_classes.definition: Vaccines & nucleic-acid immunotherapies (mRNA/sa-mRNA, conjugate vaccines, DNA-plasmid electroporation).

mechanism_classes.name: device-nondrug
mechanism_classes.definition: Non-drug devices/systems (RF energy device, robotic navigation, pathogen-reduction blood system, photodynamic therapy).

mechanism_classes.name: other-na
mechanism_classes.definition: No single clear mechanism — diagnostics-led, diversified multi-asset commercial portfolios, or corporate/earnings events without one defining modality.

tagging_rubric:
Tag each node with (a) all applicable setups[] (multi-label, mean ~2.5), (b) exactly ONE disease_area, (c) exactly ONE mechanism_class.

SETUPS -- run the v1 rubric UNCHANGED for the 15 retained tags, with ONE change: the old single-asset-microcap-binary is now three mutually-exclusive sub-tags. Pick at most one:
 - Is value in ONE lead asset AND the catalyst a Phase 3 topline / accepted BLA-NDA PDUFA / sole-remaining registrational trial? -> pivotal-company-defining-binary.
 - Same single-asset structure BUT the tape is co-dominated by solvency (runway<~18mo, going-concern, dilution/warrant/reverse-split, raise must clear around the print)? -> single-asset-going-concern-binary (also fire financing-overhang-going-concern).
 - Single asset but the catalyst is Phase 1/2/2b / dose-finding / PoC / interim (sets up a future pivotal, not the franchise binary)? -> early-mid-stage-single-asset-signal.
 Decisiveness/stage picks the bucket: PDUFA-or-Ph3 => pivotal; funding-stacked => going-concern; Ph1/2 signal => early-mid. A commercial single-product name is NOT one of these -> use commercial-single-product-quality. Then add positioning/science/regulatory tags per v1.

DISEASE_AREA (exactly one = the PRIMARY indication driving THIS catalyst). Read the indication field; if multiple, take the lead/catalyst asset's indication. Order of specificity: heme-malignancy & solid-tumor first; then organ system (nephrology, neuromuscular, neurodegeneration, then epilepsy/migraine/pain neuro, then psychiatry-cns); then immunology-inflammation vs dermatology (skin-primary -> dermatology, systemic autoimmune -> immunology); ophthalmology; respiratory; cardiovascular (incl. lipid/cardiometabolic); endocrine-obesity vs rare-genetic-metabolic (monogenic/enzyme-deficiency -> rare-genetic-metabolic); gastroenterology-hepatology; hematology-nonmalignant; infectious-disease-vaccines; allergy-anaphylaxis; urology-gynecology; supportive-procedural-other as last resort.

MECHANISM_CLASS (exactly one = the PRIMARY modality of the lead asset). Precedence when a node names several: live-biotherapeutic/phage > vaccine/DNA-mRNA > ADC/radioconjugate > ASO > siRNA > gene-therapy > cell-therapy > recombinant-protein/enzyme-biologic > Fc-fusion/ligand-trap (APRIL-BAFF axis -> april-blys-baff-fusion) > monoclonal-antibody > peptide > reformulation-delivery-device (only if the DIFFERENTIATION is the delivery, not the molecule) > device-nondrug > small-molecule-kinase-targeted-onc > small-molecule-cns > small-molecule-enzyme-receptor > small-molecule-other. Use other-na only for diagnostics, diversified multi-asset portfolios, or corporate/earnings events with no single defining modality.
coverage_note: All 470 nodes receive exactly one disease_area (0 unassigned) and exactly one mechanism_class (only 1 node -> other-na: cid 1041 BMRA, a diagnostics company with no single drug mechanism). Setups remain multi-label; every node still gets >=1 setup under the v1 rubric (v1 coverage ~96-99%). SINGLE-ASSET SPLIT PREVALENCE (keyword estimator over 165 detected single-asset nodes; the original v1 tag hit ~237 under looser matching): pivotal-company-defining-binary 76 (~16% of corpus), single-asset-going-concern-binary 70 (~15%), early-mid-stage-single-asset-signal 19 (~4%). Each is well under the 30% target; even scaled to the full ~237 original members the proportions stay <25%. CEILING: sub-setup counts are a keyword heuristic over free-text (thesis/reference_class/why), not a re-tag; the downstream LLM wave applies the definitions above node-by-node. Ambiguous single-asset nodes with no explicit stage default to pivotal-company-defining-binary, so early-mid is a conservative floor.
